messages.author: Pink_Elephants
messages.text:
**FUMBLES FINDS NEW WAY TO FIX SOMETHING THAT WASN’T BROKEN**

WN95HL — Commissioner Tommy Fumbles has apparently identified the league’s newest crisis: posting a save state once simply isn’t annoying enough.

His solution? Post it twice.

Players already post states in Discord, which also powers TickleWeb, the system Ticklepuss spent considerable time building around the league’s existing workflow. Critics say Fumbles’ proposed second posting requirement threatens to flush that work straight down the drain.

Fumbles offered this reassurance: “You keep doing what amazing things you have done there. Im just trying something else thats all.”

Critics heard something considerably different: “You keep doing what you’re doing. In the end, it won’t matter because your website is about to dry up.”

Opponents are now calling for a boycott of posting save states anywhere outside Discord, preserving the system that already works rather than feeding Fumbles’ new bureaucracy.

One league insider summed it up: “This league really can’t have nice things.”

At press time, Fumbles had not clarified whether posting a save state twice will eventually require a third post confirming the first two.
